criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the transcript does the bot say or imply it has lost access to prior data or tools it had just used.

criteria.reasoning: In follow-up questions about the same Galaxy Watch order, the bot only provides the shipping address and does not re-list all order details or multiple orders.
